CITY COUNCIL
MEM

  REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
  JANUARY 6, 2026

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Sternquist called the City Council Regular Meeting to order at 7:
  00 p.
  m.in the
  Council Chambers located at 5938 Kauffman Avenue, Temple City.

  2. ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Councilmember — Chavez, Yu, Man, Sternquist

  ABSENT:  Councilmember — Chen

  ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Cook, City Attorney Murphy, Community
  and City Clerk Kuo

  Councilmember Chavez made a motion to  excuse  Councilmember Chen for  cause.

  Seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Man.

  3. INVOCATION — Jerry Jambazian,  owner  of Wonder Cleaners and Draperies, provided
  the invocation.

  4. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE — Jennifer  Venters, Parks and  Recreation  Secretary, lead
  the pledge of allegiance.

  5. CEREMONIAL  MATTERS -  PRESENTATION

  A. Holiday Decorating Contest Winners

  Parks and Recreation  Secretary Venters gave  a  summary of the  holiday decoration
  contest.

  Mayor Sternquist and City Council recognized the contest winners.

  6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA — None

8. PUBLIC HEARING

  A. PUBLIC HEARING  RESCHEDULING  FOR ORDINANCE  NO. 25-
  1086

  City Manager Cook requested that the City Council reschedule the public hearing to
  the January 20 meeting.

  City Council did  not  have any  questions regarding the rescheduling  of the  public
  hearing.

  Mayor Sternquist opened public comment.  Hearing  no  request  to  speak, Mayor
  Sternquist closed the public comment.

  City Council received and filed the request to reschedule  the  public hearing.

9. UNFINISHED BUSINESS — None

10. NEW BUSINESS — None
